Threads live read mapping measurement
=====================================

Date: 2026-11-12
Surface: owner-authorized authenticated Orca Browser tab, https://www.threads.com/
Tab title observed: (4) Home • Threads
Logged-out check: pinned agent-browser 0.42.0 with a fresh temporary profile

Commands (read-only; no cookie/storage access):
  orca tab list --json
  orca snapshot --page <tab> --compact --urls --json
  orca exec --page <tab> --command "read" --json
  orca goto --page <tab> --url https://www.threads.com/search?q=agent%20browser
  orca scroll --page <tab> --direction down --amount 1000 --json
  orca keypress --page <tab> --key Escape --json

Observed structure (no usernames or post text retained here):
  - authenticated navigation: link "Profile Profile" (url /@<user>) and
    link "Insights Insights" (url /insights/)
  - region "Column body"
  - post blocks: clickable generic with direct author link (/@<user>),
    permalink link (/@<user>/post/<id>), StaticText body paragraphs,
    Like/Reply/Repost/Share buttons
  - thread continuation posts are sibling blocks with N / M counters
  - post page: root post plus same-author thread continuation; external replies
    were not rendered in the measured page
  - Insights overview: Views, Viewers, Net followers, Interactions only
  - New thread / Reply: dialog with heading, textbox and Post button; no form
    action URL and no submit performed
  - logged-out: login dialog and Continue with Instagram; no authenticated nav

Validation against the saved full measured snapshots (content not logged):
  feed: 4 parsed posts
  search: 3 parsed posts
  post: 6 parsed posts (root + same-author thread continuation)
  The first feed snapshot was still showing status "Loading..." and parsed 0
  posts; after the page settled it parsed 4. The adapter now polls the snapshot
  while a Loading status is present and no posts exist, bounded by the operation
  deadline.

Sanitized fixtures: docs/research/testdata/threads-live/*.ax.txt
No cookies, storage, tokens, profile export or raw personal content were read
or written. All fixture usernames, text, IDs and media alt text are synthetic.

Live write measurement (2026-11-12, owner-authorized throwaway account)
======================================================================

Commands (write): orca click --element <ref>, orca fill --element <ref>
--value <text>, orca snapshot --compact --urls --json. Writes were paced; text
was neutral "test" plus an ISO timestamp. No captcha or rate-limit banner was
seen.

Compose:
  - nav button "New thread" opened a dialog with heading "New thread",
    textbox "Empty text field. Type to compose a new post.", Post button.
  - clicking "Post" with empty text left the page unchanged (no submission).
  - after a fill, clicking "Post" closed the dialog and left an accessibility
    status toast: status > generic > image + generic > link "View" whose URL is
    the new /@<user>/post/<id>.

Posts published (5, including one intentional duplicate):
  1. text only, ack View URL observed ~3s after the click.
  2. emoji + Vietnamese diacritics, ack View URL observed ~3s after the click.
  3. 470-character long text, ack View URL observed ~3s after the click.
  4. text containing https://example.com: the URL rendered as a separate link
     (with a link-card preview); ack View URL still observed ~3s after click.
     Read mapping keeps the surrounding StaticText but not the embedded link.
  5. the exact text from post 2 again: Threads accepted the duplicate and
     returned a new URL; no duplicate rejection was observed.
  Click command durations: 0.48s, 0.79s, 1.16s, 1.48s, plus 1.31s for the
  first measured post.

Replies published (3):
  - to the account's own post: inline composer textbox plus button "Reply"
    after typing; the reply appeared as a sibling post block under the parent
    with its own /post/<id> permalink. Click command 1.07s.
  - to another author's public post: reply count changed 49 -> 50; the reply
    permalink page showed the parent block plus the reply block. Click 1.59s;
    new reply URL observed ~5s after the click.
  - nested reply to the account's own reply: status toast with View URL to the
    nested reply; reply permalink page showed root -> reply -> nested reply.
    Click 1.31s; View URL observed ~4s after the click.
  - clicking a post's "Reply N" metric opened a dialog with heading "Reply",
    a textbox and a Post button (reply-dialog fixture).

Multi-line note: fill collapsed "\n" characters into one line. Emoji and
Vietnamese diacritics survived. A multi-line composer path was not measured.

Re-read: every text-only post/reply permalink was opened and its StaticText
matched the submitted text. URL posts expose the URL as a separate link node,
so only the surrounding text is present in the parsed body.

Unknown/failure: no post or reply produced an ambiguous on-screen error. An
empty submit is a no-op. The adapter therefore records a missing acknowledgement
within the deadline as unknown and never retries the click. Logged-out remains
the measured login dialog.

Multi-line follow-up (2026-11-12)
=================================

`orca fill` flattens newlines. `orca inserttext` inserted nothing into the
Threads contenteditable. `orca type` sends real keystrokes: in the "New thread"
dialog a typed newline became a LineBreak in the composer; in the inline reply
composer a plain newline submitted the reply after the first line. The stable
path for both composers is: focus the textbox, type each line, and run
`orca exec --command "press Shift+Enter"` between lines.

Live checks:
  - post 1: 3 lines + emoji + blank line. The composer text held all breaks;
    the post permalink re-read with the three text lines, but the deliberately
    blank line collapsed (no empty paragraph in the parsed body).
  - post 2: 3 lines with Vietnamese diacritics and emoji. Re-read preserved all
    three lines with \n.
  - post 3: exact harness-style sequence (type line, Shift+Enter, type line,
    Shift+Enter, type line) in the New thread dialog. Re-read preserved all
    three lines with \n.
  - reply: 2 lines typed with Shift+Enter in the inline composer. Re-read
    preserved both lines with \n.
  Each write still showed the same status toast View URL acknowledgement
  (~2-4s) and no captcha or rate-limit banner. All text was neutral test text.

Sanitized fixtures: post-live-multiline.ax.txt, reply-live-multiline.ax.txt.
